name: designer
description: Designer workbench for code-first design/UX decision & quality assurance across Claude Code & Codex CLI (ADR-0042). The third L3 persona after engineer and founder: the six universal cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine) re-anchored to UX/UI/CTA/flow — pre-code design thinking (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture) plus a post-code quality-critique loop that evaluates rendered screenshots + frontend code under usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency lenses. Composes the image L2 capability for generated imagery rather than re-implementing it (designer never calls an image generation API); Figma and external design tools are excluded in v1 (code-first scope). Incubating scaffold — the persona flips to Accepted after a real-topic dogfood; this release completes the persona surface by adding the designer:start single-deliverable lifecycle macro (Phase 0 continuity through investigate -> frame -> decide -> compose -> critique -> refine, with user-approval gates at the direction and the spec, and a convergence-guarded terminal that hands the saved spec to the frontend rather than dispatching or auto-committing) and the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills, plus the shared design-anchored orchestration and ensemble-protocol references (the Design Task Profile, bilingual EN/KO triggers, the image L2 artifact-handoff boundary, and six ensemble point types whose peer path is code/text-only because the companion bridge has no image channel) and the L4 design profiles (general / flow / ui / cta / content) wired to their decision presets. It builds on the earlier refine (the critique -> refine -> re-critique convergence loop, never clearing a usability/conversion problem by opening a new accessibility barrier), critique (host-direct vision quality lenses held to a single internalized quality-criteria reference, accessibility a candidate-only veto gate), decide (a 7-axis design/UX decision registry — usability + an archetype axis decisive, accessibility a veto gate), compose (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture, and component specs each annotated with accessibility + consistency acceptance criteria), investigate (cited design brief), and frame (UX problem model with measurable success metrics) surfaces, the scaffold, catalogs, release wiring, staged shape test, and the copy-trimmed non-dispatch workflow-continuity machinery and hooks.
